Executive Biography & Vision

Karthick Krishna M. S. is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Coralgenz Global, an unfunded Indian IT & product engineering house headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Known for his hands-on executive leadership, he integrates high-level corporate governance with deep technical architecture and lead UI/UX design.

He pioneered the Dual-Role Leadership Model at Coralgenz Global—ensuring every client engagement receives direct founder-level engineering oversight without bureaucratic middle management. Under his stewardship, Coralgenz Global expanded into an official partner of Microsoft and Salesforce while building an ecosystem of proprietary developer software serving over 50,000+ people worldwide.

Key Executive Focus Areas

Strategic Growth & Alliances
Guiding international enterprise partnerships across Microsoft Azure, Copilot AI, and Salesforce Lightning ecosystems.
Lead UI/UX & Design Architecture
Authoring intuitive, high-converting product interfaces, design systems, and executive dashboards.
Proprietary Software Engineering
Conceiving and architecting Coralgenz Compiler, SecureVault AES-256 zero-knowledge security, and QR Enterprise suite.
Zero-Debt Engineering Standards
Mandating universal SOLID code structures, automated CI/CD validation, and complete client IP ownership.

Technical Proficiencies & Specializations

Enterprise System Architecture UI/UX Design Systems Full-Stack JavaScript/TypeScript Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Zero-Knowledge Cryptography REST & GraphQL APIs Progressive Web Apps (PWAs) Microsoft Azure & Copilot AI Product Management

Executive Tri-Leadership Alignment

Karthick Krishna works in direct tandem with Thanvanth.H (Chief Operating Officer) and Sharveshwaran R (Chief Technology Officer) to execute founder-led governance, operational velocity, and engineering excellence across all global accounts.
